instructions.name: assign_match
docs: Base, operator. Binds an Active tesoro_core Match of this Game to a table and its current epoch, once. The
Players are copied from the Match, the start deadline is fixed here, and the Match's refund timer is held past
the whole table window.

instructions.name: begin_match
docs: Rollup, permissionless. Starts the Assignment's Match on its table: only if the table is Idle at exactly the
assigned epoch with seats, the tesoro_core Match is still Active and a ring slot is free. Everything about the
Match comes from the Assignment, never from the caller. It reserves the slot and binds the table's Battle to
the Match; the Match starts when both Players have checked in.

instructions.name: blast
docs: Rollup. Declares a Blast of `piece`. Checks public state only: live, your turn, nothing pending,
`expected_seq`, the clock, the piece is yours and on the board, and no step has been made this turn (not in a
Two-Step Turn). Whether it is an Engineer is decided by `resolve`; a Blast of anything else costs the turn.

instructions.name: check_in
docs: Rollup. A Player checks in. When both have, setup opens: each Player has a minute to contribute entropy, and
the Match must be dealt within the setup window.

instructions.name: claim_timeout
docs: Rollup, permissionless. Past the start window or the setup windows it ends the Match by who showed up (the one
who did wins, nobody is a no-show, both with the oracle late is a refund). In a live Match it declares a timeout: once
the turn's deadline has passed the turn is lost (three in a row lose the Match), once the time cap has passed
the Match ends on the tiebreak. Which of the two is decided now, from the clock, and `resolve` applies it.

instructions.name: close_assignment
docs: Base, permissionless. Closes an Assignment once tesoro_core has frozen its Match (the receipt exists) or the
Match account is gone; the rent goes back to whoever paid it.

instructions.name: commit_table
docs: Rollup, permissionless. Commits the finished table and its Battle to Solana, paid by the Sponsor. The first
commit of a result is owed once (the table is `dirty` until then). A commit can be lost on its way to base
without the rollup noticing, so it may be repeated while the ring holds a young Done result, with a wait that
doubles from two minutes to an hour (see `table_kit::CommitGuard`); nobody can drain the Sponsor by calling it
again and again. Only these two public accounts are ever committed: the Armies are ephemeral.

instructions.name: contribute_entropy
docs: Rollup. A Player folds a fresh secret in. It goes into the Player's own Army only, and neither the table nor
the Battle is written, so the transaction touches nothing both Players can read. The secret is spent at the
deal. A client never sends a secret twice.

instructions.name: create_fuel
docs: Base, operator. Creates a reserve the operator later empties into the Sponsor.

instructions.name: create_sponsor
docs: Base, operator. Creates the Sponsor that pays commits; `lamports` is its first balance.

instructions.name: create_table
docs: Base, operator. Creates a table of the current generation and its Battle, the table funded for its seats' rent.

instructions.name: deal
docs: Rollup, permissionless. Once the answer is in: derives the seed, draws the sides, both layouts and the storm,
writes each Army's ranks and sealing key and its share of the storm, zeroes every secret and half, and starts
the first turn's clock. The US Army moves first; which seat plays it is the draw. The seed is never stored.

instructions.name: delegate_fuel
docs: Base, operator. Delegates a fuel reserve.

instructions.name: delegate_sponsor
docs: Base, operator. Delegates the Sponsor, once.

instructions.name: delegate_table
docs: Base, operator. Delegates a table and its Battle to the TEE validator, once.

instructions.name: finalize
docs: Base, permissionless. Settles the tesoro_core Match from the result in the committed table's ring, by CPI
signed by this Game's `authority` PDA. Without a result it refunds only when the table has demonstrably moved
past the Assignment's epoch without the Match. Only starts the settlement in tesoro_core; its chunks follow.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Pays the settlement receipt's rent in tesoro_core.

accounts.name: table
docs: program) and contents are checked in `finalize`.

instructions.name: init_seats
docs: Rollup, permissionless, once per table. Creates the two Army seats as ephemeral accounts behind private
permissions with no member. The table pays the rent. They are never closed while the table runs.

instructions.name: move_piece
docs: Rollup. Declares a move: checks only public state (the Match is live, it is your turn, nothing is pending,
`expected_seq` is the Battle's `action_seq`, the piece is yours and on the board, the square is on the board,
not a wadi, on a straight or diagonal line, not yours and not the square it just came from) and freezes the
clock decision on the declare time. Reads no Army, so what it answers cannot depend on a hidden rank.
`sealed_switch` is the Player's sealed Become a Spy byte (always sent, see `engine::seal_pad`); it is only
stored. The move is applied by `resolve` in a later slot, which checks the rank rules; a move they refuse
costs the turn.

instructions.name: pass
docs: Rollup. Declares a pass, which counts as a missed turn. `sealed_slot` seals the Dig in: 0 is a plain pass, else
the Major to dig in (see `engine::seal_pad`), so a face-down Dig in is this very instruction with the same
public effect. Public checks as `blast`, without a piece.

instructions.name: refill_sponsor
docs: Rollup, operator. Moves lamports from a fuel reserve into the Sponsor.

instructions.name: refund_untabled
docs: Base, permissionless. Refunds a joined Match that no table was ever assigned to, once it has
waited `TABLE_WAIT_SECS`, by CPI signed by this Game's `authority` PDA. Refused whenever an
Assignment exists for the Match, so it can never touch a Match a table has claimed.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Pays the settlement receipt's rent in tesoro_core.

instructions.name: release_slot
docs: Rollup, permissionless. Frees a Done ring slot once tesoro_core has frozen its Match (the receipt, read a
minute after it was written), or once the Match account itself has been gone for 15 days. A missing or
doubtful read keeps the slot.

instructions.name: request_vrf
docs: Rollup, permissionless. Asks the oracle for this Match's randomness, once. The program chooses the input: the
table, the Match, the epoch, the request number and the hashes of both frozen secrets. The answer is accepted
only for this request.

instructions.name: rescue
docs: Rollup. Declares a Rescue of the Truck by `piece`. Same public checks as `blast`; whether `piece` is a Colonel
with a Truck on the board is decided by `resolve`.

instructions.name: reset_table
docs: Rollup, permissionless. Wipes the finished Match from the public table and its Battle and moves to the next
epoch. Needs the result committed (`dirty` cleared), the seats wiped and a short delay for clients to read the
final board. The ring is kept.

instructions.name: resolve
docs: Rollup, permissionless, no arguments. Applies the pending action in a slot after its declare: it unseals the
declaring Player's switch (and a pass's Dig in) with that Army's key, applies them only to an action the rank
rules allow, then runs the rank rules, the fight, the Spotted and raid bookkeeping, the turn pass, the storm, the
caps, the no-legal-action check, the end reveal and the events. It never fails on hidden state: an action the
rank rules refuse costs the turn, and every value of a sealed byte decodes to something defined. The next
deadline counts from the resolve time, but never from later than the declare time plus `RESOLVE_SLACK_SECS`: a
slow resolve never eats the next Player's time, and a held-back one buys none. A decided game writes its
result into the ring.

instructions.name: retire_seats
docs: Rollup, operator only. Retires a table's seats: closes both Armies and their permissions and returns the rent
to the table. Only an idle table with blank seats; this is the one place a seat's history may open, and
nothing a Player can call reaches it.

instructions.name: seat_players
docs: Rollup, permissionless. Hands both seats to the Match's Players: each seat must be blank, then it is stamped
with its Player and its permission member is swapped from nobody to that Player. Only before play begins;
never on a Player's call into a live Match.

instructions.name: set_config
docs: Base layer, upgrade authority only. Names the TEE validator the tables may be delegated to and the oracle
queue its VRF requests go to, so the program has no compiled-in cluster address and a mainnet deploy needs no
code change.

instructions.name: set_table_config
docs: Base, upgrade authority only. Names the operator, the current table generation (which may only rise) and how
many tables a generation may have.

instructions.name: skip_epoch
docs: Rollup, permissionless. Gives up an Assignment whose Match never began: the table is Idle at
the Assignment's epoch and the start window has passed, so `begin_match` can never accept it.
Writes a Draw for it into the ring (the way `expire_start` writes one) and marks the table
for a commit, so `finalize` refunds the Match from a committed result without waiting for the
table's next Match. The epoch is untouched, so a later Assignment for it can still begin. At
most once per Match (the ring refuses a second slot).

instructions.name: start_two_step
docs: Rollup. The Player to act spends a banked Two-Step Turn before the first step of the turn. Public state only;
does not move the deadline.

instructions.name: void_table
docs: Rollup, permissionless. A table whose Match tesoro_core has already frozen (it refunded, say after an outage)
before the table produced a result is given up: the reserved slot is freed, the Battle is cancelled and the
table moves to Over, ready to wipe its seats and reset.

instructions.name: vrf_callback_store
docs: Rollup. VRF callback: splits the oracle's output into a half per Army. Accepted only for the one outstanding
request of the current epoch, named by its marker address, only while the Match is still in setup, and only
once: a late output can never restart a cancelled Match or reach a wiped seat.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

accounts.name: request
docs: request. The account itself need not exist.

instructions.name: wipe_seats
docs: Rollup, permissionless. Once the Match is over (or voided): zeroes both seats and swaps their permission
members to nobody, so nothing the Players could read is left and the seats are never without a private
permission. The next `seat_players` hands them on.

errors.name: NotAPlayer
errors.msg: Signer is not a Player of this Match

errors.name: BadTesoroMatch
errors.msg: The tesoro_core Match is not an Active Match of this Game

errors.name: InvalidValidator
errors.msg: Delegation must name the TEE validator

errors.name: PermissionNotReady
errors.msg: A permission for this account is missing or is not a real permission

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority
errors.msg: Only the program's upgrade authority may do this

errors.name: WrongPhase
errors.msg: Not valid in this phase of the Match

errors.name: EntropyIncomplete
errors.msg: Both Players must contribute entropy and the VRF output must arrive first

errors.name: ActionPending
errors.msg: An action is waiting to be resolved

errors.name: NothingPending
errors.msg: No action is waiting to be resolved

errors.name: StaleSeq
errors.msg: The action was sealed for an earlier turn

types.name: Army
docs: One side's private state: a hidden seat of the table. It is a rollup-only account behind a private permission,
created once with the table and kept for its life. Between Matches its data is zeroed and the permission's member
is swapped to nobody and then to the next Player; the account and its permission are never closed or left without
a private permission while a Match may be live.

fields.name: player
docs: The Player who may read this seat now; default while the seat is wiped.

fields.name: side
docs: 0 US, 1 Italy; `UNSET` until `deal`.

fields.name: ranks
docs: Rank of each of this side's pieces, by `id % 30`; 0 for an empty slot.

fields.name: fuel
docs: Supply Truck moves used.

fields.name: truck_turn
docs: The turn number the Truck last moved on.

fields.name: moves
docs: Moves this side made, written on every move so a Truck move writes the account like any other.

fields.name: reserved
docs: The 32-byte sealing key of this Army (`engine::seal_keys`), written at `deal`, private to its Player and
zeroed by `wipe`. It seals the switch and Dig in bytes this Player sends (`engine::seal_pad`).

fields.name: contributed
docs: This Player folded a secret in for the Match.

fields.name: secret
docs: This Player's secret, until `deal` spends it.

fields.name: half_set
docs: This seat's half of the oracle's output, until `deal` spends it.

fields.name: ext_entropy
docs: Reserved for entropy a future confidential source may write; mixed into the seed. Zero today, and no
instruction writes it.

fields.name: dealt
docs: `deal` ran: ranks, key and storm share are in.

fields.name: storm_at
docs: This Army's XOR share of the storm's turn. The other Army holds the rest; neither alone says anything.

fields.name: storm_seed
docs: This Army's XOR share of the storm's line seed.

types.name: Assignment
docs: The write-once binding of one tesoro_core Match to one table and one epoch. Created on base by the operator, read
by the table in the rollup and by `finalize` on base.

fields.name: players
docs: Seat 0 opened the tesoro_core Match, seat 1 joined (the Players' authorities).

fields.name: start_deadline
docs: Unix time by which both Players must have checked in.

fields.name: payer
docs: Who paid this account's rent; it goes back there when the Assignment is closed.

types.name: Battle
docs: The public Battle. Readable by both Players and by spectators; holds no hidden rank. Zero-copy: at 1.3 KB it
is too big to deserialize on the SBF stack. The layout has no padding (fields ordered by alignment, flags as
`u8`), so a client can read it at fixed offsets.

fields.name: moved
docs: Bit `id` set when that piece already moved this turn.

fields.name: deadline
docs: The turn's deadline: whole rollup seconds.

fields.name: ring
docs: The last 16 records, slot `seq % 16`.

fields.name: sq
docs: Square of each piece number, `NO_SQ` when off the board.

fields.name: shown
docs: Revealed rank of each piece (0 while hidden). A piece that left the board keeps the rank it was shown with.

fields.name: trail
docs: The last squares each piece stood on, newest last (the shuttle rule).

fields.name: authority_bump
docs: Canonical bump of the `authority` PDA, stored so settlement never re-derives it.

fields.name: us_seat
docs: Which seat plays the US Army (`UNSET` until `deal`).

fields.name: finalized
docs: 1 once settled or refunded (or found already refunded).

fields.name: permissioned
docs: 1 once the permissions exist (so `close_match`, not `close_unstarted`, closes it).

fields.name: winner
docs: A seat, `DRAW` or `NO_WINNER`.

fields.name: turn
docs: The army to act: 0 US, 1 Italy.

fields.name: two_step
docs: Two-Step Turns banked per army.

fields.name: timeouts
docs: Timeouts in a row per army.

fields.name: depot_claimed
docs: 1 when the depot each army raids is claimed.

fields.name: layout_version
docs: `LAYOUT_VERSION` this Battle was created with.

fields.name: rules_version
docs: `RULES_VERSION` this Battle was created with. A program upgrade never changes the rules of a Battle in
flight: the numbers below are stored at create and deal.

fields.name: setup_deadline
docs: The Match must be dealt by now; past it `claim_timeout` cancels it.

fields.name: cap_deadline
docs: The time cap: set at `deal` to `started_at + cap_secs`.

fields.name: payer
docs: Whoever pressed create and prepaid the rent.

fields.name: oracle_queue
docs: The oracle queue its VRF request goes to, copied from the config at create.

fields.name: opening_grace_secs
docs: Extra seconds on the opening turn.

fields.name: pending_kind
docs: `PENDING_*`: a declared action that only `resolve` (in a later slot) may apply. While one is pending nothing
else is accepted. It holds public intent and timing only, never a rank, and cannot be changed or cancelled.

fields.name: pending_seat
docs: The seat that declared a move (a timeout claim reads 0).

fields.name: pad_a
docs: `pad_a[0]` is the SEALED switch byte of the pending move, Blast, Rescue or pass (`plain ^ pad`, see
`engine::seal_pad`); a timeout claim leaves it 0. Cleared with the pending action. The other two bytes are
unused.

fields.name: action_seq
docs: Counts declared actions: the n-th pending action is the one `resolve` applies.

fields.name: pending_slot
docs: The rollup slot of the declare. `resolve` needs a later one.

fields.name: pending_time
docs: The rollup time of the declare: the clock decision was made on it and is not made again.

fields.name: deal_slot
docs: The slot `deal` ran in. Nothing is declared in it, so the sides cannot be read out of a bundle with `deal`.

fields.name: resolve_slack_secs
docs: See `engine::RESOLVE_SLACK_SECS`.

fields.name: reserved
docs: `reserved[..8]` is the END MASK: bit `id` (little endian `u64`, piece numbers 0-59) is set for every piece
whose rank changed in the Match (a Major that dug in, a General of the Army that became a Spy), dead pieces
included. Written when the Match ends, never before. The rest is unused.

fields.name: tries
docs: Commits sent since the last result landed.

fields.name: last_at
docs: Rollup time of the latest one.

fields.name: oracle_authority
docs: Trusted for now to supply the issuance price and `YieldAccrued`/`PositionLocked` facts.
This is the seam for the LayerZero receiver (messages) and Pyth (price).

fields.name: platform_recipient
docs: `TesoroAccount` that receives the Platform Fee.

fields.name: legacy_games
docs: Unused since the per-Game records; its bytes stay so older accounts keep their layout.

fields.name: leaderboard_bps
docs: Leaderboard Fee in basis points of the Pot. Appended after `games`: an account created
before it reads the fields as zero (the unused tail of the account is zeroed) and is
extended by `init_leaderboard`.

fields.name: pool_account
docs: The Leaderboard Pool: `TesoroAccount` owned by the `["leaderboard"]` address. Zero until
`init_leaderboard`; the fee is off while it is.

fields.name: leaderboard_since
docs: Unix time `init_leaderboard` first ran: Matches opened before it were not charged the fee, so
readers show the fee only for Matches opened at or after it. Zero until then.

fields.name: entry_sizes
docs: Entry sizes in Gemas, zero-padded. All zero until `set_entry_sizes`: the default ladder
(100 / 500 / 1,000) applies, so an older Config needs no call. Appended after the Leaderboard
fields: an account created before reads them as zero from its zeroed tail.

fields.name: oracle_locked
docs: Set by the admin on mainnet (`set_oracle_lock`): the oracle key can no longer register
Positions, report their yield or name an Advance's price (test-mode paths), so a stolen
oracle key cannot mint Gemas. Appended last: an older Config reads it as false.

types.name: Fuel
docs: A delegated lamport reserve the operator empties into the Sponsor inside the rollup (a base transfer to a
delegated PDA is not seen there).

types.name: GameRecord
docs: One Game. Registered once by whoever controls its program (see `registry`); changed only by
that same control, after `GAME_CHANGE_DELAY_SECS`. Listing is written by the admin.

fields.name: game
docs: The Game program's id.

fields.name: settle_authority
docs: Only this key may settle the Game's Matches (a PDA of the Game program, or a server key).

fields.name: studio_recipient
docs: `TesoroAccount` that receives the Studio Fee.

fields.name: pending_at
docs: Unix time a proposed change was made; zero while none is waiting.

fields.name: pending_by
docs: The control key that proposed it. Applying needs the same key to be in control still.

fields.name: listed_until
docs: The Game counts as listed until this unix time (admin). Zero: never listed.

fields.name: approved_slot
docs: The deploy slot the admin approved. A program upgraded since has a different slot and
counts as unlisted until the admin approves again.

fields.name: approved_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the approved build's executable bytes without trailing zeros (`registry::code_hash`).
A moved slot keeps the listing only through `refresh_listing`, which proves the bytes are these.

fields.name: listing_epoch
docs: Counts the builds the admin approved: bumped by `list_game` only when it sets a different
hash, never by `refresh_listing`. A Match remembers the epoch it opened under, so a moved
deploy slot with the same epoch is the same build.

types.name: MatchId
docs: A Match id: the opener's Account and its counter value. Never reused: the counter only grows
and Accounts can't be closed and re-created.

types.name: MatchMeta
docs: What a Match carries explicitly now that the id is only a counter.

fields.name: listed
docs: The Game's listed status when the Match opened (an unlisted Game earns no Points).

fields.name: deploy_slot
docs: The Game program's deploy slot when the Match opened.

fields.name: deadline
docs: After this time anyone may refund the Match as abandoned (extendable, never past the
absolute deadline).

fields.name: deadline_abs
docs: Settlement must start before this; fixed at open.

fields.name: pot_lines
docs: Lines each side's Pot held when it was put in (the Pot never gains lines).

types.name: MatchState
docs: A Match. The Pots (the Tickets' lines) live in the two Ticket accounts named in `pots`.

fields.name: listed
docs: The Game was listed when the Match opened: only then does a win earn Points.

fields.name: listing_epoch
docs: `GameRecord.listing_epoch` when the Match opened.

fields.name: payer
docs: Who paid the rent of this account; it goes back there when the Match is closed.

fields.name: pots
docs: The Ticket account that is each side's Pot (the default key until the side joined).

fields.name: room
docs: Slots held in Accounts' stores for the lines this Match will credit (`room_reserved` of
each spill counts them). Every credit that takes a new slot pays the holder's share down;
`close_match` hands back what is left.

types.name: Party
docs: One entrant. `funder == player` unless the entry is Backed; then `share_bps` is the Player's
share of the surplus from the accepted Offer.

types.name: Phase
docs: A phase of a run. A Win is `Cuts(loser) -> Back(winner) -> Surplus`, a No-show is
`Cuts(0) -> Cuts(1) -> Back(0) -> Back(1)`, a refund is `Back(0) [-> Back(1)]`.

types.name: Receipt
docs: The settlement receipt written when the Match enters Settling or Refunding: the outcome is
frozen in core from then on. Tables read its existence as proof their result slot is spent.

fields.name: kind
docs: 0 for a slot never written, else one of the `EVENT_*` kinds.

types.name: RoomHold
docs: Slots of one Account's stores held for a Match.

types.name: Run
docs: The frozen plan and its cursor. Fixed size: it does not grow with the Pot, so the Match record
stays one small account whatever the number of lines. Which line a fee is cut from is not
listed up front: the cut walks the loser's Pot lines in order from the cursor, which only moves
forward, so a replayed or interleaved chunk continues exactly where the last one stopped.

fields.name: fees
docs: Platform, Studio, Leaderboard totals in Gemas (a No-show: Platform only, both sides).

fields.name: cut_left
docs: Fee Gemas still to cut from each side's lines, per class.

fields.name: player_left
docs: Gemas of the surplus still owed to the Player (Backed winner), frozen at the start.

fields.name: match_key
docs: The tesoro_core Match this slot belongs to.

fields.name: epoch
docs: The table epoch the Match ran in.

fields.name: at
docs: Rollup clock when the result was written.

types.name: Sponsor
docs: A program-owned lamport holder, delegated once, that pays the commits as the fee payer.

types.name: Table
docs: A persistent table. Delegated once and never undelegated in normal running; only this account and the public
`Battle` are ever committed to Solana. Its two `Army` seats are rollup-only accounts that live as long as it does.

fields.name: epoch
docs: Rises at every reset; a Match is bound to one epoch.

fields.name: seats_created
docs: The two Army seats exist (created once, kept for the table's life).

fields.name: seats_open
docs: The seats belong to the current Match's Players.

fields.name: dirty
docs: The result is in and not yet committed.

fields.name: tesoro_match
docs: The Match on the table (default key while Idle).

fields.name: slot
docs: Its ring slot.

fields.name: vrf_nonce
docs: Counts VRF requests on this table, never reset. The callback of request `n` must name the address
`["vrfreq", table, n]`, so an answer to any other request is refused.

fields.name: req_nonce
docs: The number of the latest request.

fields.name: req_pending
docs: A VRF request is outstanding.

fields.name: req_made
docs: The one request of this Match was made (never cleared until the next Match).

fields.name: vrf_ready
docs: The answer arrived and waits for `deal`.

fields.name: ring
docs: Results of finished Matches, kept until tesoro_core has frozen them.

fields.name: commit
docs: When the table may be committed again if a commit was lost on its way to base.

types.name: TableConfig
docs: The program's table settings: the operator (the key that creates tables and assigns Matches), the current table
generation (which may only rise) and the table cap. Not named `Config`: tesoro_core owns that name in the IDL.

types.name: Terms
docs: Fee terms snapshotted when the Match opened. The Leaderboard Fee is read when settling starts.

fields.name: studio_owner
docs: `None`: Tesoro's own Studio Fee, a Source counter. `Some(account)`: an outside studio,
paid as a fee line in its basket.

fields.name: studio_priority
docs: The Game was listed when the Match opened: its Studio Fee is a senior fee class, repaid
right after the Platform Fee. Otherwise it is paid as ordinary won Gemas into the
recipient's basket (`studio_owner` must then be set).

fields.name: authority
docs: Solana wallet that controls the Account.

fields.name: evm_address
docs: The EVM family address of the Account (zero until set).

types.name: VanguardConfig
docs: The program config: which validator the Battle may be delegated to and which oracle queue answers its VRF
requests. Set at deploy by the upgrade authority; nothing about the cluster is compiled in.
